title: The Exponential Time Hypothesis is False
importance_reason: public: Lino's YouTube channel, in a narrator voice, explaining a complexity-theory result experts are still checking; a viewer may repeat any claim
audience: A developer on YouTube who knows roughly what P versus NP is, or has heard of it, and saw the headline that an AI refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. After watching, they can say what 3-SAT and ETH are, how ETH relates to P versus NP, what the paper claims and the core idea of how, why it does not make SAT solvers faster or settle P versus NP, and how far to trust it today.

Did an AI Just Refute the Exponential Time Hypothesis? Opus 5.5 Explains
description: On October 26, OpenAI posted a paper called "The Exponential Time Hypothesis is False". One of its models wrote it, and OpenAI says a proof checker has verified it. If it holds, a floor under how fast hard problems can be solved, one that hundreds of papers have assumed for 25 years, isn't there.

I had Opus 5.5 explain it, so this is one AI explaining another AI's paper, and it says so. It covers what ETH is and how it relates to P versus NP, the three ideas behind the new algorithm, and how far to trust it while the team checking it, led by two of the people who proposed ETH, hasn't reported yet (as of October 27, 2026).

I made this video with ShipShow, my open-source toolkit of skills and plugins that lets AI agents build narrated videos like this one, end to end. The narrator is an invented voice, not a real person. https://github.com/latent-variable/shipshow
